entry: V2.21 default pre5/post2; same candidate strict body-clear checks and10percent wick penetration; short keys at/above Monday low, no upper restriction for long keys. Entry only after post2 close on Tue-Fri NY.
exit: First profitable 15m 2/2 pivot after entry, market fill at confirmation close; native initial stops precede that close. No end-of-day exit; residual positions marked at study end separately.
controls: One deterministic random entry per signal without replacement, same symbol, side, UTC week, chronological half and ATR14/close bucket; Tuesday-Friday NY close only; real arrows/entries excluded. Preserve signal relative initial risk, round stop outward to tick. Same exit and fees.
tie_sensitivity: Latest-equal pivot versus strictly unique extreme; no return-driven choice. TradingView tie handling is undocumented.
limitations: Idealized zero-latency close fills on 5m OHLC, no funding/spread/depth. R is independent original-risk return, not an account percentage. Known historical data, no training or parameter search.
stops: V2.21 original uses touch extreme plus entry0.2percent rounded outward. Exact-wick bridge changes only this stop, retaining pairing and control time; nonpositive/tick-invalid risk excluded, not rematched.
comparison: Owner-requested historical default comparison plus same-stop bridge. Reuse17 approved exits and causal pivot. Full-year rankings are descriptive; no selection or promotion.
